method: Playwright-operated gameplay; the portrait and landscape runs each start from a fresh local save.

sceneOrder.interaction: Open the map-first management screen with no tab navigation.

sceneOrder.scene: Select a guest room on the island
sceneOrder.interaction: Select an arriving guest; available room tiles glow.

sceneOrder.scene: Room assigned and marked on the map
sceneOrder.interaction: Tap a room tile and show the occupant marker.

sceneOrder.scene: Live arrivals and one-tap room planning
sceneOrder.interaction: Show guest cards and use automatic room planning.
Open the night and review satisfaction, revenue, and guest outcomes.

sceneOrder.scene: Blueprint sheet from the main screen
sceneOrder.interaction: Open the build catalog as an overlay sheet.

sceneOrder.scene: Glowing build sites on the island
sceneOrder.interaction: Select the solar blueprint and reveal connected placement tiles.
Place the solar facility and inspect it on the map.
End on a 4.5-second still captured from the live game after earning three postcards.

editingNote: No aspect-ratio crop was used. Each landscape and portrait version was recorded in its native responsive layout. The postcard hold is an actual app capture used as a readable end card.
